name: Mac
title: ClipDiff for Mac
description: Compare the last two things you copied, from a small app in your menu bar.
steps: Start ClipDiff. It appears in the menu bar.
Copy the older text or text file, then copy the newer one.
Press Option + Command + C, or choose Show Diff from the ClipDiff menu.
files: Copy two files together in Finder to compare them immediately. For Finder context-menu commands, choose Enable Finder menu in ClipDiff and enable ClipDiff Finder Integration in System Settings.
viewers: Use the built-in side-by-side or unified view, or choose another application, including MacDiff, Kaleidoscope, Beyond Compare, or Visual Studio Code.
setup: See the Mac project for build and setup instructions. The local release script builds ClipDiff.app and opens it. Finder integration is enabled separately in System Settings.
